mission.description: Harch Corp is a sovereign infrastructure conglomerate founded in Casablanca, Morocco, with a clear mission: build Africa's industrial sovereignty through the vertical integration of AI, energy, and technology. We operate across 8 subsidiaries in 5 countries, controlling the entire value chain — from raw material to finished product.
mission.title: Our Mission
mission.headline: Convert Potential Into Power
mission.paragraph1: Africa holds 30% of the world's mineral reserves, 60% of its uncultivated arable land, and the youngest population on Earth. Yet the continent has historically captured only a fraction of this value.
mission.paragraph2: Harch Corp exists to change this equation. We build the industrial infrastructure — from AI compute to water security — that enables Africa to own its future. Not through aid or extraction, but through sovereign, vertically integrated industrial development.
mission.paragraph3: Our model is simple but radical: we own the entire value chain. From the energy that powers our operations to the technology that optimizes them, every link is under our control. This creates structural cost advantages of 30-50% and ensures that value stays on the continent.
mission.label: Mission & Vision
mission.quote: Africa does not need aid. It needs infrastructure — owned, operated, and controlled by Africans. That is the only path to sovereignty.

historySection.label: Our History
historySection.paragraph1: Harch Corp was founded in 2024 by Amine Harch El Korane in Casablanca, Morocco. The founding conviction was simple: Africa's industrial sovereignty is the defining opportunity of this century, and it can only be seized by building — not by importing, not by extracting, not by waiting.
historySection.paragraph2: The company is structured as a holding (Harch Corp) with eight planned subsidiaries (filiales), each activated in sequence under the Build One At A Time methodology. No filiale is launched until the previous one reaches profitability. Disciplined capital allocation over growth-at-all-costs.
historySection.paragraph3: The 100-year vision: by 2050, 30 filiales operating across 40 countries, generating $50B+ in annual revenue. By 2124, Harch Corp intends to be Africa's largest industrial conglomerate — owned, operated, and controlled by Africans.

glossary.noResultsDescription: Try a different search term or browse all terms.

aiInference.definition: The process of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data. HarchOS provides optimized inference endpoints with sub-50ms latency.

airGapped.definition: A security measure where systems are physically isolated from unsecured networks. HarchOS supports air-gapped deployments for classified government workloads.

api.definition: Application Programming Interface — a set of protocols for building and integrating software. HarchOS provides REST, gRPC, and WebSocket APIs.

carbonAwareComputing.definition: Computing that adapts workload scheduling based on the carbon intensity of the energy grid. HarchOS implements real-time carbon-aware scheduling across all hubs.

carbonIntensity.definition: The amount of CO2 emitted per kilowatt-hour of electricity generated. HarchOS achieves 48.2 gCO2/kWh — 89% below the global average.

cloudComputing.definition: On-demand delivery of compute resources over the internet. HarchOS provides sovereign cloud computing with guaranteed African data residency.

compute.definition: Processing power provided by CPUs or GPUs for running workloads. HarchOS offers GPU compute with H100, A100, and L40S accelerators.

containerization.definition: Packaging applications with their dependencies into portable containers. HarchOS supports containerized workloads with live migration across hubs.

dataCenter.definition: A facility housing computer systems and associated components. HarchOS operates 5 sovereign data centers across Morocco.

dataSovereignty.definition: The principle that data is subject to the laws of the country where it is stored. HarchOS guarantees 100% African data sovereignty with Morocco jurisdiction.

desalination.definition: The process of removing salt from seawater to produce fresh water. Harch Water operates AI-optimized desalination plants across Morocco.

dpa.definition: Data Processing Agreement — a legal contract between data controllers and processors. Required for GDPR compliance in all HarchOS deployments.

edgeComputing.definition: Processing data closer to where it is generated rather than in a centralized data center. HarchOS supports edge computing for IoT and industrial workloads.

egress.definition: Data transferred out of a network or cloud service. HarchOS offers reduced egress fees with sovereign data residency guarantees.

esg.definition: Environmental, Social, and Governance — a framework for evaluating corporate sustainability. Harch Corp integrates ESG across all subsidiaries.

fogComputing.definition: An extension of cloud computing that brings processing closer to data sources. HarchOS uses fog computing for real-time industrial monitoring.

freeTier.definition: A no-cost usage tier with limited resources. HarchOS offers a free tier with 10 GPU-hours per month for development and testing.

gpu.definition: Graphics Processing Unit — specialized hardware for parallel computing. HarchOS provides NVIDIA H100, A100, and L40S GPUs for AI workloads.

greenComputing.definition: Environmentally sustainable computing practices. HarchOS implements green computing through carbon-aware scheduling and renewable energy.

greenHydrogen.definition: Hydrogen produced using renewable energy through electrolysis. Harch Energy is developing green hydrogen projects across Morocco.

grpc.definition: A high-performance RPC framework using Protocol Buffers. HarchOS provides gRPC services for low-latency inter-service communication.

harchOS.definition: The operating system for sovereign infrastructure — HarchOS unifies monitoring, decision-making, and execution across 8 subsidiaries using the SENSE-THINK-ACT paradigm.

hyperscale.definition: Massive-scale cloud computing infrastructure. HarchOS is designed for hyperscale deployment with multi-hub orchestration.

iaas.definition: Infrastructure as a Service — cloud computing that provides virtualized computing resources. HarchOS offers sovereign IaaS with African data residency.

inference.definition: The process of running predictions through a trained model. HarchOS provides optimized inference with sub-50ms p99 latency.

islamicFinance.definition: Financial services compliant with Islamic law (Sharia). Harch Finance offers Sharia-compliant investment products including Sukuk.

iso27001.definition: An international standard for information security management. HarchOS is ISO 27001 certified across all data centers.

kubernetes.definition: An open-source container orchestration platform. HarchOS integrates with Kubernetes for workload management and auto-scaling.

latency.definition: The time delay between a request and response. HarchOS achieves <100ms intra-Morocco latency and <10ms between hubs.

llm.definition: Large Language Model — AI models trained on vast text datasets. HarchOS provides optimized hosting for sovereign LLM deployment.

loadBalancer.definition: A device that distributes network traffic across multiple servers. HarchOS uses intelligent load balancing with carbon-aware routing.

microservices.definition: An architectural style where applications are composed of small, independent services. HarchOS is built on a microservices architecture.

multiTenant.definition: A software architecture where multiple customers share the same infrastructure. HarchOS provides secure multi-tenancy with resource isolation.

onPremises.definition: Software or infrastructure installed and run on the user's premises. HarchOS supports on-premises deployment for classified environments.

openapi.definition: A specification for machine-readable interface files for REST APIs. HarchOS APIs are documented using the OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

paas.definition: Platform as a Service — cloud computing that provides a platform for developing and deploying applications. HarchOS offers sovereign PaaS with carbon-aware optimization.

pemElectrolysis.definition: A method of producing hydrogen using a solid polymer electrolyte. Harch Energy uses PEM electrolysis for green hydrogen production.

phosphateMining.definition: The extraction of phosphate minerals for use in fertilizers and industrial applications. Morocco holds 75% of the world's phosphate reserves.

precisionAgriculture.definition: Farming management using IoT, AI, and satellite data to optimize crop yields. Harch Agri provides precision agriculture across West Africa.

pue.definition: Power Usage Effectiveness — a metric for data center energy efficiency. HarchOS targets a PUE of 1.10 at its best hub ().

rbac.definition: Role-Based Access Control — a method of restricting system access based on user roles. HarchOS implements granular RBAC across all services.

renewableEnergy.definition: Energy from sources that are naturally replenishing. HarchOS data centers are powered by 82.3% renewable energy on average.

restApi.definition: Representational State Transfer API — an architectural style for web services. HarchOS provides a comprehensive REST API for all platform operations.

saas.definition: Software as a Service — cloud-based software delivery model. HarchOS offers SaaS solutions for infrastructure management and monitoring.

senseThinkAct.definition: The HarchOS architectural paradigm — SENSE collects data, THINK analyzes and decides, ACT executes operations autonomously.

soc2.definition: Service Organization Control 2 — a compliance framework for service providers. HarchOS is SOC 2 Type II certified.

sovereignAi.definition: AI systems that operate within a country's legal jurisdiction with guaranteed data sovereignty. HarchOS provides sovereign AI with Morocco data residency.

sovereignCloud.definition: Cloud infrastructure that operates within a specific jurisdiction with guaranteed data residency. HarchOS is Africa's first sovereign GPU cloud.

submarineCable.definition: Undersea fiber-optic cables that carry data between continents. Morocco connects to Europe via 3 submarine cable systems: Marea, ACE, and AA-1.

sukuk.definition: Islamic financial certificates similar to bonds but compliant with Sharia law. Harch Finance offers Sukuk-based investment products.

terraform.definition: An infrastructure as code tool for provisioning and managing cloud resources. HarchOS provides Terraform providers and modules for sovereign deployments.

throughput.definition: The amount of data processed in a given time period. HarchOS achieves 10TB/day log ingestion and 1M+ data points per second.

verticalFarming.definition: Growing crops in vertically stacked layers using controlled environments. Harch Agri is developing vertical farming solutions for urban Africa.

verticalIntegration.definition: A business strategy where a company controls its entire supply chain. Harch Corp's vertical integration spans from raw materials to finished products.

virtualization.definition: Creating virtual versions of computing resources. HarchOS uses hardware virtualization for GPU allocation and multi-tenant isolation.

waterDesalination.definition: The process of removing salt and minerals from seawater. Harch Water operates AI-optimized desalination plants across Morocco.

webhook.definition: An HTTP callback triggered by specific events. HarchOS provides webhooks for real-time event notifications and integrations.

hero.headline: Sovereign GPU Cloud.
hero.subtext: HarchOS is the operating system for Africa's first carbon-aware GPU compute platform — powered by Morocco's renewable energy advantage. Open-source from day one.
hero.label: HarchOS /0.1

why.title: Three problems. One platform.
why.subtitle: The AI infrastructure gap in Africa isn't just about hardware — it's about sovereignty, sustainability, and scale.

sovereign.title: Sovereign AI
sovereign.desc: AI workloads in Africa route through US and EU data centers by default. Every inference call, every training run, every dataset leaves the continent. HarchOS keeps data on African soil — by default, not by configuration. Every deployment enforces data residency at the infrastructure level with three sovereignty tiers: strict, regional, and global.

carbon.title: Carbon-Aware Computing
carbon.desc: Training a single LLM can emit over 300 tonnes of CO2. On a fossil-heavy US grid, that number multiplies. Morocco's grid runs on solar, wind, and CSP — averaging 48.2 gCO2/kWh versus 400+ in the US. HarchOS doesn't just run workloads — it schedules them when and where carbon intensity is lowest, without sacrificing performance.

panAfrican.title: Pan-African Infrastructure
panAfrican.desc: Africa has 1% of global compute capacity for 17% of the population. That gap is widening, not closing. HarchOS is building the infrastructure to reverse this trend — starting from Morocco's strategic position at the crossroads of Europe and Africa, with undersea cables reaching both continents.

why.label: Why HarchOS /0.2

hubs.title: Five hubs. Morocco's renewable advantage.
hubs.subtitle: Each hub is strategically located near renewable energy sources. Combined, they form Africa's largest planned GPU mesh — 1,798 GPUs (target) across solar, wind, and hybrid installations.
hubs.disclaimer: Hub specifications are planned targets. Actual deployment timelines depend on infrastructure development and regulatory approval.
hubs.label: Hub Network /0.3

architecture.title: SENSE. THINK. ACT.
architecture.subtitle: HarchOS operates on a three-layer architecture inspired by autonomous systems — observe the grid, predict the optimal path, execute with precision. Every layer is open-source and auditable.

sense.title: SENSE
sense.subtitle: Real-time grid monitoring
sense.desc: Continuous ingestion of carbon intensity data from national grid APIs, energy spot pricing from Moroccan utilities, GPU utilization metrics from all hubs, and inter-hub network reliability telemetry. The SENSE layer maintains a real-time topology graph of every GPU, including NVLink bandwidth, PCIe lane assignments, and cooling capacity.
sense.specs: Carbon API feeds, Energy market data, Hub telemetry, Regional grid status, NVLink topology, Cooling metrics

think.title: THINK
think.subtitle: Carbon-aware intelligence
think.desc: The ML-powered scheduling engine that predicts the optimal hub, time window, and GPU configuration for each workload. It considers carbon intensity forecasts, spot pricing trends, workload latency requirements, and sovereignty constraints simultaneously — optimizing for the Pareto frontier of cost, carbon, and performance.
think.specs: Carbon prediction model, Cost optimization engine, Workload profiler, Sovereignty validator, Spot pricing forecaster, Latency calculator

act.title: ACT
act.subtitle: Autonomous orchestration
act.desc: Deploys, migrates, and scales workloads automatically based on THINK layer decisions. Supports live migration between hubs when carbon conditions shift — moving a training job from Tanger to Ouarzazate when solar output peaks. Zero-touch operations with self-healing and automated failover.
act.specs: Auto-deployment, Cross-hub migration, Auto-scaling, Self-healing, Live migration, Automated failover

architecture.label: Architecture /0.4

opensource.title: Open-source from day one.
opensource.subtitle: The entire HarchOS platform is open-source. Server, SDKs, CLI, Terraform provider, Grafana plugins, examples — everything. We believe sovereign infrastructure requires transparent code.
opensource.desc: Every component is developed in the open on GitHub under permissive licenses (Apache 2.0, MIT, MPL). You can audit, fork, contribute, or self-host. Sovereign infrastructure can't be sovereign if you can't read the code that runs it.
opensource.label: Open Source /0.5

sdkPython.title: Python SDK — pip install harchos
sdkPython.desc: The official Python SDK provides OpenAI-compatible inference with built-in carbon tracking. Every API response includes carbon footprint data — gCO2 emitted, renewable percentage, and the hub that served your request. Supports async workloads, SSE streaming, and a context manager for carbon-aware batch processing.
sdkPython.features: OpenAI-compatible, Carbon tracking, SSE streaming, Async support, CLI included, Pydantic models
sdkPython.label: Python SDK /0.6

sdkJs.title: TypeScript SDK — npm install @harchos/sdk
sdkJs.desc: The TypeScript/JavaScript SDK brings sovereign defaults to Node.js. Every client is initialized with region='morocco', sovereignty='strict', and carbonAware=true — you have to explicitly opt out of carbon-awareness, not opt in. Full type safety, carbon intensity queries, optimal hub finder, and workload scheduling.
sdkJs.features: Typed API client, Sovereign defaults, Carbon intensity, Hub finder, Workload scheduler, Zero-config
sdkJs.label: TypeScript SDK /0.7

cli.title: CLI — harchos
cli.desc: Written in Go for single-binary cross-platform distribution. Sovereign by default, multi-profile configuration, structured output (JSON/YAML/table), and CI/CD-friendly with --dry-run and --quiet modes. Secure credential storage via system keyring. Available via Homebrew, binary download, or build from source.
cli.features: Single binary, Multi-profile, Structured output, CI/CD ready, System keyring, Cross-platform
cli.label: CLI /0.8

terraform.title: Terraform Provider — Infrastructure as Code
terraform.desc: Manage HarchOS workloads, models, inference endpoints, datasets, network policies, and storage volumes with Terraform. Define sovereignty levels in HCL — and once set, sovereignty cannot be downgraded. The provider enforces this at the API level. Available on the Terraform Registry as HarchCorp/harchos.
terraform.features: 6 resources, 3 data sources, Sovereignty enforcement, Carbon thresholds, Registry published, HCL-native
terraform.label: Terraform /0.9

grafana.title: Grafana Plugins — Observe Everything
grafana.subtitle: Six custom Grafana plugins for GPU monitoring, carbon tracking, hub health, workload distribution, and carbon forecasting. Introduces two custom query languages: EnergyQL for energy metrics and SovereigntyQL for compliance auditing.

datasource.title: HarchOS Data Source
datasource.desc: Connect Grafana directly to HarchOS hubs. Query real-time GPU utilization, carbon metrics, hub health, and sovereignty status with custom query languages.

gpuPanel.title: GPU Utilization Panel
gpuPanel.desc: Visualize GPU utilization across all hubs. Drill down by hub, rack, or individual GPU. Track memory, compute, and thermal metrics in real time.

carbonPanel.title: Carbon Metrics Panel
carbonPanel.desc: Track carbon emissions per workload, per hub, or per project. Compare against grid averages and renewable targets. Historical trend analysis.

hubHealth.title: Hub Health Panel
hubHealth.desc: Monitor hub operational status including power supply, cooling capacity, network connectivity, and GPU availability across the mesh.

workloadDist.title: Workload Distribution
workloadDist.desc: Visualize how workloads are distributed across hubs. See carbon-aware routing decisions in real time. Identify optimization opportunities.

forecast.title: Carbon Forecast Panel
forecast.desc: Predict future carbon intensity based on weather forecasts, solar/wind generation predictions, and grid demand patterns. Plan workloads accordingly.

grafana.label: Grafana /0.10

carbon.title: Carbon Intelligence
carbon.subtitle: HarchOS doesn't just run workloads — it understands the carbon impact of every compute decision and actively minimizes it.

realtime.title: Real-Time Carbon Tracking
realtime.desc: Every API response includes a carbon_footprint object with gCO2 emitted, renewable percentage, and the serving hub. Track your carbon impact per request, per session, or per project with zero additional API calls.

prediction.title: Carbon Intensity Forecasting
prediction.desc: ML models predict carbon intensity 24-48 hours ahead using weather forecasts, solar generation curves, wind speed predictions, and historical grid patterns. Schedule training jobs when carbon intensity will be lowest.

routing.title: Carbon-Aware Workload Routing
routing.desc: The THINK layer automatically routes workloads to the greenest available hub. If Ouarzazate's solar output peaks at 2PM, your training job gets routed there. If Dakhla's wind picks up at midnight, batch processing shifts automatically.

reporting.title: Compliance & ESG Reporting
reporting.desc: Generate carbon reports per project, per team, or per organization. Export in formats compatible with GHG Protocol, CDP, and EU CSRD reporting frameworks. Built-in audit trail for regulatory compliance.

carbon.label: Carbon Intelligence /0.11

sovereignty.title: Sovereignty by default.
sovereignty.subtitle: Data sovereignty isn't a feature — it's the architecture. HarchOS enforces sovereignty at three levels, and once set, it can never be downgraded.

strict.title: STRICT
strict.desc: Data and workloads never leave the designated hub. All processing, storage, and inference happen within a single facility. Maximum data isolation for government, defense, and regulated industries.
strict.rules: No cross-hub transfer, Single hub only, Air-gapped option

regional.title: REGIONAL
regional.desc: Workloads can move between hubs within the same geographic region (Morocco). Enables carbon-aware routing within the country while keeping data on sovereign soil. Recommended for most enterprise workloads.
regional.rules: Within Morocco only, Carbon-aware routing, Cross-hub migration

global.title: GLOBAL
global.desc: Workloads can span multiple regions across Africa. Enables pan-African mesh networking for distributed training and low-latency inference across the continent. Data still never leaves Africa.

sovereignty.rule: Sovereignty levels are enforced at the infrastructure level and cannot be downgraded once set. A workload deployed with strict sovereignty will never be migrated to a regional or global configuration — even under failover conditions. This is a technical guarantee, not a policy.
sovereignty.label: Sovereignty /0.12

specs.title: What we're building towards.
specs.subtitle: These are our engineering targets, not current capabilities. We believe in transparency over marketing. Every number here is a commitment we're working to deliver.

compute.title: Compute
compute.items: 1,798 GPUs planned (H100 & A100), Up to 256 GPUs per workload, Target PUE: 1.10, NVLink interconnect

network.title: Network
network.items: 400 Gbps backbone, <5ms inter-hub latency, 3 submarine cable paths (Marea, ACE, AA-1), Redundant mesh routing

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.items: Target 48.2 gCO2/kWh avg, Up to 97% renewable (Ouarzazate), Carbon-aware scheduling, Real-time carbon tracking

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.items: Target 99.9% SLA, RPO <15min, RTO <30min, Automated failover

specs.label: Specifications /0.13

security.title: Security by design. Sovereignty by default.

zeroTrust.title: Zero-Trust Architecture
zeroTrust.desc: Every request is authenticated and authorized — no implicit trust between services, hubs, or users. Mutual TLS between all hub components. Service mesh with per-request identity verification.

dataResidency.title: Data Residency Enforcement
dataResidency.desc: Workloads and data never leave the designated region. Technical enforcement at the infrastructure level, not just policy. Encryption keys are region-bound and cannot be exported. Verified by automated compliance checks.

encryption.title: End-to-End Encryption
encryption.desc: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest. HSM-backed key management in every hub. Keys never leave the sovereign region. Support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) for maximum control.

compliance.title: Compliance Framework
compliance.desc: Designed for GDPR, Morocco's Law 09-08, and SOC 2 Type II from the ground up. Compliance isn't bolted on — it's built into the architecture. Automated audit trails and continuous compliance monitoring.

security.badges: GDPR, Law 09-08, SOC 2, TLS 1.3, HSM, BYOK
security.label: Security /0.14

roadmap.title: Building in phases. Shipping with discipline.
roadmap.subtitle: Our roadmap is public because accountability matters. Every phase has clear deliverables and measurable outcomes.

roadmap.label: Roadmap /0.15

refonte.heroSubtext: Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration on Moroccan soil. H100s from $1.80/hr. 90-second provisioning. 5 hubs. 99.98% SLA. Data stays in Africa.
refonte.overviewTitle: Africa's first sovereign AI compute platform.
refonte.overviewBody: HarchOS is the operating system for sovereign AI compute — built and operated in Morocco, powered by renewable energy, and open-source from day one. Every workload runs under Moroccan data sovereignty law (Loi 09-08). No US CLOUD Act exposure. No GDPR conflicts. No data replication outside the continent. Just clean, fast, carbon-aware GPU compute — accessible from a single CLI command.
refonte.problemTitle: Africa imports 95% of its AI compute.
refonte.problemBody: Every inference call, every training run, every dataset leaves the continent by default. The current model is broken — technically, legally, and economically.
refonte.archBody: HarchOS operates on a three-layer architecture inspired by autonomous systems — observe the grid, predict the optimal path, execute with precision. Every layer is open-source and auditable.
refonte.archSenseDesc: Continuous ingestion of carbon intensity data from national grid APIs, energy spot pricing, GPU utilization metrics, and inter-hub network telemetry.
refonte.archSenseSpecs: Carbon API feeds · Energy market data · Hub telemetry · NVLink topology · Cooling metrics
refonte.archThinkDesc: ML-powered scheduling engine that predicts the optimal hub, time window, and GPU configuration. Optimizes the Pareto frontier of cost, carbon, and performance.
refonte.archThinkSpecs: Carbon prediction model · Cost optimizer · Workload profiler · Sovereignty validator
refonte.archActDesc: Deploys, migrates, and scales workloads automatically. Supports live migration between hubs when carbon conditions shift — moving training from Tanger to Ouarzazate when solar peaks.
refonte.archActSpecs: Auto-deployment · Cross-hub migration · Self-healing · Automated failover
refonte.archDiagramCode: your code → API → scheduler → GPU fleet → output
refonte.archNote1: Workload arrives via SDK or CLI
refonte.codeBody: OpenAI-compatible inference with built-in carbon tracking. Every response includes gCO2 emitted, renewable percentage, and the serving hub. Async workloads, SSE streaming, and a context manager for carbon-aware batch processing.
refonte.codeBullet4: Async support + SSE streaming built in
refonte.gpuSubtitle: Scale from 1 to 1,024 GPUs in 90 seconds. NVLink, InfiniBand, liquid cooling. Powered by 100% renewable energy.
refonte.netTitle: Five hubs. One mesh. Zero egress.
refonte.netBody: Submarine cable connectivity via Marea, ACE, and AA-1. Redundant mesh routing. Sub-50ms latency from African edge. No data leaves the continent.
refonte.dashTitle: See every GPU. Every job. Every gram of CO₂.
refonte.dashSubtitle: Real-time cluster telemetry — from the Ouarzazate hub. Refreshed every 5 seconds.
refonte.calcTitle: What will your training run cost?
refonte.calcSubtitle: Drag the sliders. See your monthly bill. Compare to AWS p5.48xlarge. All prices in USD.
refonte.calcDisclaimer: Estimates only. Spot pricing available at 40% discount. Reserved capacity commits 1-year for additional 20% off.
refonte.cmpSubtitle: Built different. Built sovereign. Built in Africa.
refonte.sovTitle: Sovereign by design. Not by configuration.
refonte.sovBody: Data sovereignty isn't a feature — it's the architecture. HarchOS enforces sovereignty at three levels, and once set, it can never be downgraded.
refonte.carbonTitle: Powered by Moroccan sun and wind.
refonte.carbonBody: HarchOS doesn't just run workloads — it understands the carbon impact of every compute decision and actively minimizes it.
refonte.modelsBody: Deploy in one command. Pay per token. Sub-50ms latency from the African edge.
refonte.termTitle: From zero to training in 90 seconds.
refonte.termSubtitle: No DevOps team required. Just a terminal.
refonte.hubsBody: Each hub is strategically located near renewable energy sources. Combined, they form Africa's largest planned GPU mesh — 1,798 GPUs (target) across solar, wind, and hybrid installations.
refonte.hubsDisclaimer: Hub specifications are planned targets. Actual deployment timelines depend on infrastructure development and regulatory approval.

accessibility.commitmentDescription: Harch Corp is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply relevant accessibility standards to ensure our website and digital services are perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust for all users. Accessibility is not just a compliance obligation for us — it is a core principle that aligns with our values as a responsible corporate citizen and our mission to serve diverse communities across Africa and beyond. We invest in accessibility because we believe everyone should have equal access to information about our company, services, and opportunities.
accessibility.standardsDescription: Our website is designed and developed to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA, as published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI). These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities and more user-friendly for everyone. We also reference additional accessibility standards and frameworks, including Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act (United States), the European Standard EN 301 549, and the Kingdom of Morocco's accessibility requirements under the framework of the National Initiative for People with Disability.
accessibility.featuresIntro: We have implemented the following accessibility features across our website:

features.description: Our website is fully navigable using keyboard controls. All interactive elements, including menus, forms, links, and buttons, can be accessed and operated using standard keyboard shortcuts and the Tab key.

We have designed our website to be compatible with leading screen readers, including JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver. We use semantic HTML, ARIA landmarks, and descriptive labels to ensure screen reader users can effectively navigate and understand our content.

We maintain color contrast ratios that meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA requirements (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text). Our typography is designed for optimal readability, with appropriate line heights, letter spacing, and font sizes.

Our website is fully responsive and adapts to different screen sizes and devices. Content remains accessible and usable whether viewed on desktop, tablet, or mobile devices, with no loss of information or functionality.

All meaningful images on our website include descriptive alternative text that conveys the purpose and content of the image. Decorative images are hidden from assistive technologies using appropriate ARIA attributes.

All form fields have associated labels, clear instructions, and meaningful error messages. Required fields are clearly indicated, and form validation provides specific, actionable feedback to help users correct errors.

Visible focus indicators are provided for all interactive elements to help keyboard users track their position on the page. Focus order follows a logical sequence that matches the visual layout of the content.
We provide skip navigation links that allow keyboard users to bypass repetitive navigation elements and jump directly to the main content area of each page.

accessibility.limitationsIntro: Despite our best efforts, some accessibility limitations may exist on our website. We are actively working to address these:

limitations.description: Some third-party content embedded on our website, such as interactive maps and video players, may not fully conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards. We are working with our third-party providers to improve the accessibility of this content.

Some older PDF documents and downloadable resources may not be fully accessible to screen readers. We are in the process of converting these documents to accessible formats and ensuring all new documents are published in accessible formats.

Real-time data visualizations and live operational dashboards may present challenges for some assistive technologies. We are developing alternative text-based representations for these dynamic content areas.

Archived content published before our accessibility initiative may not meet current standards. We are prioritizing the remediation of high-traffic and critical content while maintaining an ongoing remediation schedule for the remaining archive.

accessibility.feedbackDescription: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of our website. If you encounter any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please let us know. We take all feedback seriously and will make reasonable efforts to address accessibility issues promptly.
accessibility.contactAddress: Address: Harch Corp, 123 Boulevard Mohammed V, Casablanca 20000, Morocco
accessibility.contactResponseTime: We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 3 business days and to propose a resolution within 10 business days.
accessibility.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | This statement is reviewed quarterly and governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco.

ccpa.title: CCPA Compliance
ccpa.description: This notice describes the rights of California residents under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and how Harch Corp handles personal information subject to this regulation.
ccpa.rightsDescription: The California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), provides California residents with specific rights regarding their personal information. Harch Corp is committed to complying with the CCPA/CPRA and respecting the privacy rights of all California consumers. This notice describes the categories of personal information we collect, the purposes for which we use that information, and the rights available to you under California law.
ccpa.categoriesDescription: In the preceding 12 months, we have collected the following categories of personal information:

categories.examples: Name, email address, phone number, IP address, account login credentials
Name, signature, physical characteristics, address, telephone number, passport number
Age, date of birth, citizenship, immigration status (collected for employment purposes only)
Records of products or services purchased, investment interests, transaction details
Fingerprints, voice prints, facial recognition data (collected for facility access only)
Browsing history, search history, interaction with our website, cookie data
Physical location derived from IP address or mobile device (generalized to city level)
Work history, professional qualifications, employment application data
Profile reflecting preferences, characteristics, behavior, or attitudes

ccpa.howWeUseDescription: We may use or disclose the personal information we collect for the following business or commercial purposes: to provide, maintain, and improve our services and website; to process transactions and send related information including confirmations and invoices; to respond to your comments, questions, and requests, and provide customer service and technical support; to communicate with you about products, services, offers, and events offered by Harch Corp; to monitor and analyze trends, usage, and activities in connection with our services; to detect, investigate, and prevent fraudulent transactions and abuse; to personalize and improve your experience on our website; to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims; and to comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes.
ccpa.yourRightsDescription: As a California resident, you have the following rights under the CCPA:

rights.description: You have the right to request that we disclose what personal information we collect, use, and disclose about you over the past 12 months. This includes the categories of personal information collected, the categories of sources, the business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling the information, the categories of third parties with whom we share information, and the specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you. We will verify your identity before disclosing this information.

You have the right to request that we delete any personal information about you that we have collected from you, subject to certain exceptions. These exceptions include when the information is necessary to complete a transaction, detect security incidents, protect against fraud, debug or repair errors, exercise free speech, comply with legal obligations, or enable solely internal uses reasonably proportional to your relationship with us. Upon a verified deletion request, we will direct our service providers to delete your personal information from their records.

rights.right: The Right to Opt-Out of Sale
rights.description: You have the right to direct us not to sell your personal information at any time. We do not currently sell personal information as defined under the CCPA. However, if our practices change, we will provide clear notice and an opt-out mechanism. You may also authorize an agent to exercise this right on your behalf by providing a signed power of attorney.

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA rights. This means we will not deny you goods or services, charge you different prices or rates, provide you a different level or quality of goods or services, or suggest that we may do any of the foregoing, because you exercised a CCPA right. We may offer certain financial incentives permitted by the CCPA that are reasonably related to the value of your personal data, provided they are voluntary and clearly described.

ccpa.exerciseDescription1: To exercise any of the rights described above, please submit a request by emailing us at dpo@harchcorp.com or by calling our toll-free number (available to California residents). We will respond to your request within 45 days of receipt, as required by the CCPA. If we need more time, we will inform you of the reason and extension period in writing.
ccpa.exerciseDescription2: You may also designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf. To do so, you must provide the authorized agent with written permission to act on your behalf, and we may require verification of your identity and confirmation that you have authorized the agent to make the request. We will verify your identity before processing your request by matching the information you provide with the personal information we maintain about you.
ccpa.disclosureDescription: In the preceding 12 months, we have disclosed personal information for business purposes to the following categories of third parties: cloud infrastructure and hosting providers, analytics and performance monitoring services, marketing and communication platforms, legal and professional advisors, and regulatory authorities as required by law. We do not sell personal information to third parties. We require all service providers who process personal information on our behalf to comply with strict data protection obligations and to process personal information only for the specific business purposes for which we disclose it to them.
ccpa.doNotSellTitle: Do Not Sell My Personal Information
ccpa.doNotSellDescription1: Harch Corp does not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties for monetary or other valuable consideration. We have never sold personal information in the past 12 months and do not intend to do so in the future. Should our practices change, we will update this notice and provide a clear and conspicuous “Do Not Sell My Personal Information” link on our homepage as required by the CCPA.
ccpa.doNotSellDescription2: Even though we do not sell personal information, we respect your privacy choices. If you have any concerns about how your information is shared, please contact us at dpo@harchcorp.com.
ccpa.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | This notice applies to California residents and is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco and the State of California where applicable.

codeOfConduct.title: Code of Business Conduct
codeOfConduct.description: The Harch Corp Code of Conduct defines the ethical standards and behavioral expectations that guide every director, officer, and employee across all our operations worldwide.
codeOfConduct.purposeAndScopeDescription: This Code of Business Conduct (“Code”) establishes the ethical standards and behavioral expectations that govern the conduct of all directors, officers, employees, contractors, and agents of Harch Corp and its subsidiaries, joint ventures, and affiliated entities worldwide. The Code applies to all business activities and relationships, whether conducted in person, electronically, or through third-party representatives. It reflects our commitment to integrity, transparency, and accountability in everything we do. Compliance with this Code is mandatory, and violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment or business relationship, as well as potential legal consequences.
codeOfConduct.ourValuesIntro: At Harch Corp, our values are not abstract principles — they are the foundation of every decision we make and every action we take. We expect all members of the Harch Corp community to embody these values:
codeOfConduct.valueIntegrityDescription: We act honestly, ethically, and transparently in all our dealings. We do the right thing even when no one is watching.
codeOfConduct.valueExcellenceDescription: We pursue the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do, from industrial operations to stakeholder engagement.
codeOfConduct.valueRespectDescription: We treat every person with dignity and respect, valuing diversity of thought, background, and experience across our organization.
codeOfConduct.valueAccountabilityDescription: We take responsibility for our actions and their consequences. We honor our commitments and own our mistakes, learning from them to improve.
codeOfConduct.ethicalFrameworkIntro: When faced with an ethical dilemma, we encourage all members of the Harch Corp community to use the following framework to guide their decision-making:
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep1Description: Consider whether the proposed action complies with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies. If it is not legal, do not proceed.
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep2Title: Is it consistent with our values?
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep2Description: Does the action align with our core values of integrity, excellence, respect, and accountability? Would you be comfortable seeing this action reported in the media?
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep3Title: Would you be comfortable if everyone did it?
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep3Description: Apply the universalizability test: if everyone in your position took the same action, would the outcome be acceptable? If not, reconsider.
codeOfConduct.ethicalStep4Description: If you are unsure about the right course of action, consult your manager, the Compliance Office, the Legal Department, or the Ethics Hotline before proceeding. It is always better to ask than to assume.
codeOfConduct.keyPoliciesIntro: The following policies are integral components of our Code of Business Conduct:

keyPolicies.description: Harch Corp maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward corruption and bribery in all forms, whether involving public officials or private sector counterparts. We comply with the Kingdom of Morocco's anti-corruption laws, the UK Bribery Act, the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, and all applicable anti-corruption legislation in jurisdictions where we operate. No employee, officer, or agent may offer, promise, give, or accept any bribe, kickback, or improper inducement. All business hospitality and gifts must be reasonable, proportionate, and properly documented. We maintain rigorous due diligence processes for third-party intermediaries, agents, and business partners.

All directors, officers, and employees are expected to act in the best interests of Harch Corp and to avoid situations where personal interests conflict or appear to conflict with the interests of the company. Conflicts of interest may arise from financial interests in competing or supplier organizations, outside employment or directorships, related-party transactions, or personal relationships that could influence business decisions. Any actual or potential conflict of interest must be disclosed promptly to the Compliance Office and managed transparently. Employees must recuse themselves from decisions where a conflict exists.

Trading in securities while in possession of material non-public information about Harch Corp or any company with which we do business is strictly prohibited. Material non-public information includes any information that a reasonable investor would consider important in making an investment decision and that has not been publicly disclosed. This prohibition extends to tipping others who might trade on such information. All employees with access to material non-public information must observe designated trading windows and pre-clearance requirements as specified in our Insider Trading Policy.

We are committed to protecting the personal data of our employees, clients, partners, and other stakeholders. All employees must comply with our data protection policies and applicable privacy laws, including the GDPR, the Kingdom of Morocco's Law No. 09-08, and other relevant legislation. Personal data must be collected only for legitimate purposes, processed lawfully and fairly, kept accurate and up to date, retained only as long as necessary, and protected against unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss. Any data breach must be reported immediately to the Data Protection Officer.

Harch Corp is committed to respecting and promoting human rights in all our operations and business relationships, consistent with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the International Labour Organization's core conventions, and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. We prohibit forced labor, child labor, and human trafficking in our operations and supply chain. We uphold the principles of non-discrimination, freedom of association, and the right to collective bargaining. We conduct human rights due diligence on our operations and supply chain and engage with stakeholders to identify and address potential impacts.

As a multi-sector industrial conglomerate, we recognize our significant environmental footprint and our responsibility to minimize it. We are committed to operating in an environmentally sustainable manner, complying with all applicable environmental laws and regulations, and continuously improving our environmental performance. Our environmental commitments include reducing greenhouse gas emissions in line with science-based targets, minimizing waste and promoting circular economy principles, protecting biodiversity in areas where we operate, investing in clean technologies and renewable energy, and transparently reporting our environmental performance. Each business unit maintains an Environmental Management System aligned with ISO 14001 standards.

codeOfConduct.reportingConcernsDescription: Harch Corp is committed to fostering an environment where employees and stakeholders feel safe to raise concerns about potential violations of this Code, company policies, or applicable laws. We provide multiple channels for reporting concerns, and all reports are taken seriously and investigated promptly.
codeOfConduct.reportingAlternative: You may also report concerns to your direct manager, the Compliance Office, the Legal Department, or the Human Resources Department. All reports will be handled confidentially to the extent possible.
codeOfConduct.nonRetaliationDescription: Harch Corp strictly prohibits retaliation against any person who, in good faith, reports a concern about potential misconduct, participates in an investigation, or exercises any right under this Code or applicable law. Retaliation includes any adverse employment action, threat, intimidation, or harassment directed at an individual because they reported a concern or participated in an investigation. Any employee who engages in retaliation will be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination. If you believe you have experienced retaliation, please report it immediately through any of the reporting channels listed above.
codeOfConduct.waiversDescription: Any waiver of this Code for executive officers or directors may be made only by the Board of Directors of Harch Corp and will be promptly disclosed to the extent required by applicable law or regulation. Waivers for other employees may be granted only by the Chief Compliance Officer in writing. The Board of Directors retains the authority to amend this Code at any time. Amendments will be communicated to all employees and stakeholders, and updated versions will be made available on our website and internal compliance portal. Continued employment or engagement with Harch Corp constitutes acceptance of any amendments to this Code.
codeOfConduct.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | Approved by the Board of Directors of Harch Corp | Governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: This policy explains how Harch Corp uses cookies and similar technologies on our website, what data they collect, and how you can manage your preferences.
cookies.whatAreCookiesDescription: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, to provide a better browsing experience, and to supply information to the owners of the site. Cookies allow websites to recognize your device and remember information about your visit, such as your preferred language and other settings. Similar technologies such as web beacons (also known as pixel tags or clear GIFs), local storage, and session storage operate in similar ways and are covered by this policy.
cookies.howWeUseIntro: Harch Corp uses cookies and similar technologies for a variety of purposes. We categorize the cookies we use into four types, each serving a distinct purpose:

cookieTypes.description: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You cannot opt out of these cookies as the website cannot function without them.
cookieTypes.examples: Session authentication tokens, CSRF protection cookies, load balancing cookies, cookie consent preferences

cookieTypes.description: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, such as which pages are visited most often and whether users receive error messages. All data collected by these cookies is aggregated and anonymized.
cookieTypes.examples: Google Analytics (_ga, _gid), page load timing metrics, error tracking identifiers

cookieTypes.description: These cookies allow the website to remember choices you make, such as your preferred language, region, or display settings. They provide enhanced, personalized features and can also be used to remember changes you have made to text size, fonts, and other customizable elements of the website.
cookieTypes.examples: Language preference, region settings, display preferences, accessibility settings

cookieTypes.description: These cookies are used to deliver advertisements more relevant to you and your interests. They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement and to help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. They are usually placed by advertising networks with our permission.
cookieTypes.examples: LinkedIn Insight Tag, retargeting pixels, conversion tracking cookies

cookies.thirdPartyDescription: In addition to our own cookies, we may use cookies from third-party service providers who operate on our behalf. These third parties include: Google LLC (Google Analytics for website analytics), LinkedIn Corporation (Insight Tag for professional audience insights), Meta Platforms, Inc. (Pixel for conversion tracking on our careers and investment pages), and Cloudflare, Inc. (security and performance optimization). These third-party cookies are subject to the respective privacy policies of these organizations. We do not control the setting of these cookies and recommend you consult the respective third-party websites for more information on their cookies and how to manage them.
cookies.managingDescription1: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. When you first visit our website, you will be presented with a cookie consent banner that allows you to select which categories of cookies you wish to accept. You may update your preferences at any time by accessing our Cookie Preferences Center.
cookies.managingDescription2: Additionally, you can manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, manage, and delete cookies. Please note that if you delete or reject cookies, you may not be able to use certain features of our website, and your user experience may be diminished. Below are links to cookie management instructions for popular browsers:
browserInstructions: Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
Apple Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data
Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Manage and delete cookies
cookies.tableIntro: The following table lists the specific cookies used on our website, their purpose, category, and duration:

cookieTable.name: _gid
cookieTable.purpose: Google Analytics — distinguishes unique visitors per day

cookies.updatesDescription: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this Cookie Policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies. If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify you through a prominent notice on our website or by other means as required by applicable law.
cookies.contactDescription: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookie Policy, please contact us at: dpo@harchcorp.com or write to us at Harch Corp, 123 Boulevard Mohammed V, Casablanca 20000, Morocco.
cookies.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | This policy is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.description: Our Data Processing Agreement sets out the terms under which Harch Corp processes personal data on behalf of our clients, ensuring GDPR compliance and robust data protection.
dpa.overviewDescription: Harch Corp recognizes that data protection is fundamental to our relationships with clients, partners, and stakeholders. Our Data Processing Agreement (DPA) establishes the terms and conditions under which we process personal data on behalf of our clients, ensuring compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Kingdom of Morocco's Law No. 09-08 on the Protection of Personal Data, and other applicable data protection laws. This page outlines the key provisions of our DPA and provides access to our DPA template for review and execution.
dpa.keyProvisionsIntro: Our DPA incorporates the following key provisions, each designed to ensure robust data protection and compliance with international standards:

keyProvisions.title: Processing Scope
keyProvisions.description: The DPA clearly defines the subject matter, duration, nature, and purpose of the processing, the types of personal data processed, and the categories of data subjects. All processing activities are documented in an annex that is reviewed and updated quarterly to reflect any changes in our data processing operations.

keyProvisions.title: Subprocessor Management
keyProvisions.description: We maintain an up-to-date list of authorized sub-processors and notify clients of any changes to sub-processors at least 30 days in advance. Clients have the right to object to the appointment of a new sub-processor. All sub-processors are bound by contractual obligations providing at least the same level of data protection as contained in the DPA. We conduct due diligence assessments on all sub-processors before engagement and review their compliance annually.

keyProvisions.title: Data Security
keyProvisions.description: We implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including encryption at rest and in transit (AES-256 and TLS 1.3), access controls and authentication mechanisms (multi-factor authentication, role-based access control), regular security testing and vulnerability assessments (annual penetration tests, quarterly vulnerability scans), employee training and confidentiality obligations, and physical security measures at our data centers and offices. Security measures are documented in our Technical and Organizational Measures (TOMs) annex.

keyProvisions.title: Audit Rights
keyProvisions.description: Clients have the right to audit our compliance with the DPA, subject to reasonable notice of at least 30 business days. Audits may be conducted by the client or by a qualified independent third-party auditor at the client's expense. We cooperate fully with audits and provide reasonable access to relevant facilities, systems, and records. We also make available current third-party audit reports, including SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certificates, to reduce the need for on-site audits.

keyProvisions.title: Breach Notification
keyProvisions.description: We notify clients without undue delay and no later than 72 hours after becoming aware of a personal data breach. Notifications include the nature of the breach, the categories and approximate number of data subjects and records concerned, the likely consequences of the breach, and the measures taken or proposed to address the breach and mitigate its effects. We also provide reasonable assistance to clients in meeting their obligation to notify supervisory authorities and affected data subjects under applicable law.

keyProvisions.title: Data Return and Deletion
keyProvisions.description: Upon termination of the DPA or at the client's request, we return or securely delete all personal data processed under the DPA within 90 days, unless retention is required by applicable law. We provide written certification of deletion upon request. For data that must be retained for legal compliance, we continue to protect such data in accordance with the DPA and applicable law and process it only for the purpose of compliance.

dpa.downloadDescription: Our standard DPA template is available for review and download. This template incorporates all mandatory provisions required by the GDPR, Moroccan data protection law, and best practices for data processing arrangements. If you require modifications to our standard template or have specific regulatory requirements, our legal team will work with you to address them.
dpa.contactDescription: To initiate the DPA execution process, request a modified DPA, or discuss specific data protection requirements for your engagement with Harch Corp, please contact our legal team:
dpa.contactAddress: Address: Harch Corp, 123 Boulevard Mohammed V, Casablanca 20000, Morocco
dpa.contactResponseTime: Response time: We aim to respond to all DPA inquiries within 5 business days.
dpa.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | This DPA is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco and incorporates GDPR requirements where applicable.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance
gdpr.description: Harch Corp is committed to full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Moroccan Law No. 09-08 on the protection of personal data.
gdpr.commitmentDescription: Harch Corp is committed to ensuring compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Kingdom of Morocco's Law No. 09-08 on the Protection of Individuals with Regard to the Processing of Personal Data. Although headquartered in Casablanca, Morocco, we recognize that our operations, partnerships, and services may involve the processing of personal data of individuals within the European Economic Area (EEA). We have implemented comprehensive data protection measures, appointed a Data Protection Officer, and established robust processes to ensure that the personal data of EU data subjects is processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently.
gdpr.legalBasisIntro: Under Article 6 of the GDPR, we process personal data only when we have a valid legal basis. The following are the legal bases upon which we rely:

legalBases.description: Where you have given clear, affirmative consent to the processing of your personal data for one or more specific purposes. You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

Where processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party, or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract. This includes processing needed to deliver our services under signed agreements.

Where processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which Harch Corp is subject, including obligations under Moroccan law, EU regulations, and other applicable jurisdictions where we operate.
Where processing is necessary to protect the vital interests of a natural person, including life-threatening situations or emergencies where the data subject is incapable of giving consent.

Where processing is necessary for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller, applicable in our capacity as a critical infrastructure operator.

Where processing is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by Harch Corp or a third party, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject. We conduct Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs) for all processing under this basis.

gdpr.dataSubjectRightsIntro: We respect and uphold the rights of data subjects as guaranteed under the GDPR. The following rights are available to all individuals whose personal data we process:

dataSubjectRights.description: You have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning you is being processed, and where that is the case, access to the personal data and information about the purposes, categories, recipients, retention period, and your right to lodge a complaint.

You have the right to obtain the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning you without undue delay. Taking into account the purposes of processing, you also have the right to have incomplete personal data completed, including by means of providing a supplementary statement.

You have the right to obtain the erasure of personal data concerning you without undue delay where the data is no longer necessary, you withdraw consent, you object to processing, or the data has been unlawfully processed. This is subject to certain exceptions, including legal obligations and the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.

You have the right to obtain restriction of processing where you contest the accuracy of the data, processing is unlawful but you oppose erasure, we no longer need the data but you require it for legal claims, or you have objected to processing pending verification of our legitimate grounds.

You have the right to receive personal data concerning you which you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, and have the right to transmit that data to another controller without hindrance. This right applies where processing is based on consent or contract and is carried out by automated means.

You have the right to object at any time to processing of personal data concerning you which is based on legitimate interests or public interest, including profiling. We shall cease processing unless we demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds or the data is needed for legal claims. You also have the right to object to processing for direct marketing at any time.

You have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which produces legal effects or similarly significantly affects you. Where such decisions are made, you have the right to obtain human intervention, express your point of view, and contest the decision.

Where processing is based on consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the legality of processing performed prior to the withdrawal. We make it easy to withdraw consent through our privacy settings or by contacting our DPO.

gdpr.dpaDescription: In accordance with Article 28 of the GDPR, Harch Corp maintains Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) with all processors and sub-processors who process personal data on our behalf. Our DPA template incorporates all mandatory provisions required by the GDPR, including the subject matter and duration of processing, the nature and purpose of processing, the type of personal data and categories of data subjects, and the obligations and rights of the controller. We make our DPA available to all business partners and clients upon request. To request a copy of our DPA template, please contact our legal team at dpo@harchcorp.com.
gdpr.internationalTransfersIntro: As a Moroccan company with global operations and partnerships, we may transfer personal data outside the EEA. We ensure that all international transfers comply with Chapter V of the GDPR through the following mechanisms:
gdpr.sccDescription: We use the European Commission's approved Standard Contractual Clauses (Controller-to-Processor and Controller-to-Controller) as the primary mechanism for transferring personal data to countries that do not have an adequacy decision. All our SCCs incorporate the latest modules and supplementary measures as required by the Schrems II decision.
gdpr.adequacyDescription: Where the European Commission has issued an adequacy decision recognizing that a country provides an adequate level of data protection, we rely on such decisions for transfers to those jurisdictions. We continuously monitor the status of adequacy decisions, including the EU-Morocco data protection framework developments.
gdpr.internationalTransfersNote: Prior to any international transfer, we conduct Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) to evaluate the laws and practices of the destination country and implement supplementary measures where necessary to ensure an essentially equivalent level of data protection.
gdpr.dpoDescription: Harch Corp has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) in accordance with Article 37 of the GDPR. Our DPO operates independently, reports directly to senior management, and is responsible for monitoring our compliance with data protection laws, advising on data protection impact assessments, and serving as the point of contact for data subjects and supervisory authorities.
gdpr.dpoAddress: Address: Harch Corp, 123 Boulevard Mohammed V, Casablanca 20000, Morocco
gdpr.supervisoryAuthorityDescription: If you are an EU data subject and believe that our processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in the EU Member State of your habitual residence, place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement. In Morocco, the relevant authority is the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP — Commission Nationale de Contrôle de la Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel). We are committed to cooperating fully with any supervisory authority in the resolution of complaints.
gdpr.footerNote: Last updated: January 2026 | This statement is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco and the GDPR where applicable.
